verdict_label: No inconsistency found by the checks that could run
reasons: No word was measured as inconsistent with its neighbours on the same line.
The amounts, dates and reference numbers read from the image agree with each other.
limitations: This tool looks for inconsistencies between words inside one image. It cannot show that an image is untouched.
A screenshot of an edited image (a re-screenshot) can hide most traces of the edit.
Small text, heavy compression and unusual fonts can cause false alarms.
Only text is examined. Changes to icons, photos, logos or layout are not detected.
This is an automated screening aid, not a certified forensic opinion. Do not rely on it alone for disputes or legal decisions.

assurance.label: No contradiction found (still unverified)
reasons: 2 content check(s) examined the text and found no contradiction.
assurance.next_step: Add a second source you did not get from the sender (reconcile mode). A screenshot that agrees with itself can still be forged.

ladder.label: No contradiction found (still unverified)
ladder.requirement: What it says is consistent with itself.

ladder.label: Consistent with an independent source
ladder.requirement: A second source you did not get from the sender (the receiver's bank SMS, a statement line, the issuer's e-mail) agrees on the reference, or on the amount and the date.

ladder.label: Confirmed by signed data
ladder.requirement: A digital signature or signed QR code that can be checked. Not available yet.

assurance.never_genuine: No level proves the screenshot is untouched. Level 2 only means an independent source agrees with it.
